title: Barkin on 30A | KEY.co
description_expanded: Stepping into this delightful residence, the open-concept first floor immediately welcomes visitors into a spacious and inviting atmosphere, perfect for family gatherings or simply relaxing with a good book. The kitchen, equipped with sleek stainless steel appliances, offers bar stool seating for six and a dining table that can comfortably accommodate eight, making meal times a pleasure. Adjacent to the kitchen, the screened-in porch provides a serene escape, perfect for al-fresco dining or enjoying a quiet moment surrounded by the gentle sounds of nature. The master suite on this level features a king-sized bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, alongside a convenient half bathroom and laundry facilities. Upstairs, the allure of comfort continues with an additional king bedroom complete with a private, luxuriously appointed walk-in shower. An open space outfitted with a TV and a cozy bunk bed setup ensures there's a perfect spot for everyone to unwind. The layout includes two more bedrooms, each with two single beds; one boasts a private bathroom while the other shares access to the hall bathroom. This home thoughtfully combines modern amenities and a dog-friendly policy, ensuring that every member of the family, including furry ones, enjoys a relaxing and memorable stay.
